skill.name: tiktok-made-me-buy-it
skill.description: Search for organic TikTok videos with PipiAds, filter by engagement and creator follower count, and summarize recurring product themes.
skill.summary: Find organic TikTok videos and compare engagement signals for product research.
skill.author: pipiads-dev

security_audit.summary: The Markdown backticks and product research terms do not indicate shell execution or system reconnaissance. The setup passes a PipiAds key to a globally installed third-party server and directs users to a separate domain for key issuance and billing. Searches consume account credits; no evidence of prompt injection or credential exfiltration was found in the reviewed file.

remediation.issue: Global installation of the PipiAds MCP server
remediation.suggestion: Make installation opt-in and isolated. Provide package provenance and integrity information so users can verify the pinned release before running it.

remediation.issue: The MCP server receives the PipiAds API key
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated key with the narrowest available permissions. Inject it through the client secret store at launch and keep it out of prompts and logs.

remediation.issue: Key issuance and billing are linked from a different domain
remediation.suggestion: Link to documentation on the declared PipiAds homepage that confirms the billing domain, or use a billing link on the declared domain.

remediation.issue: The search workflow does not define a credit budget
remediation.suggestion: Ask for a credit budget before searching. Use result limits where supported and confirm before additional calls would exceed that budget.

content.value_statement: It can be hard to tell which products attract attention in organic TikTok videos. Use PipiAds search to compare engagement and identify recurring product themes.
actual_capabilities: Search PipiAds for organic TikTok videos using product or niche keywords.
Narrow search results by video plays and likes.
Filter results by creator follower count.
Summarize recurring product themes and how creators introduce products.
limitations: Requires a configured PipiAds MCP server and a PipiAds API key.
PipiAds charges one credit per returned search result, according to the skill.
Does not cover paid advertising, TikTok Shop store analytics, or Facebook monitoring.
Video engagement indicates attention, not verified sales or conversions.

use_cases.title: Shortlist Products for Research
use_cases.description: Search organic videos in a product category and shortlist themes that appear across multiple creators.

use_cases.title: Study Product Video Openings
use_cases.description: Review high-engagement videos for recurring ways creators introduce a product or show its purpose.

use_cases.title: Compare Engagement by Creator Size
use_cases.description: Compare plays and likes for the same product keywords across creator follower ranges.

prompt_templates.title: Find Videos by Product Keyword
prompt_templates.prompt: Find organic TikTok videos about reusable lunch bags. Summarize the product features that occur most often in the results.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by Plays and Likes
prompt_templates.prompt: Search organic TikTok videos about drawer organizers with at least 10,000 plays and 500 likes. Summarize how creators introduce the product.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Creator Groups
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare organic videos about cable organizers from creators with fewer than 10,000 followers and creators with 10,000 to 50,000 followers. Report plays, likes, and recurring product themes separately.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Credit-Limited Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare organic video results for travel bottle and leakproof bottle. Ask before searching if you cannot keep the total within 20 credits. Separate recurring themes from isolated examples, and do not infer sales.
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured comparison with a spending limit

output_examples.input: Summarize product themes from a small sample of organic TikTok videos about drawer organizers.
output: Illustrative result: Three of five videos showed adjustable dividers, and two showed stackable trays.
A before-and-after drawer view was the most common opening in this sample.

output_examples.input: Compare organic videos about cable organizers for two creator follower ranges.
output: Illustrative result: Creators below 10,000 followers often showed desk setups. Creators with 10,000 to 50,000 followers more often showed travel kits.
The comparison describes this sample only and does not establish sales or conversion rates.

best_practices: Start with a specific product keyword and define a credit budget before searching.
Use consistent engagement filters when comparing groups, and report the sample size.
Keep the API key in your tool configuration and out of prompts and shared logs.
anti_patterns: Treating plays or likes as proof of sales.
Running broad searches without checking how returned results affect credits.
Using organic video results as a substitute for paid advertising or TikTok Shop analytics.

faq.question: What do I need to run the skill?
faq.answer: You need a configured PipiAds MCP server and a PipiAds API key. The installation documented by the skill requires npm.

faq.question: Does each search cost credits?
faq.answer: The skill states that PipiAds charges one credit per video returned by a search.

faq.question: Which filters can I use?
faq.answer: You can search by product or niche keywords and narrow results by plays, likes, and creator follower count.

faq.question: Can I use it for paid ads or TikTok Shop analytics?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow covers organic TikTok videos, not paid ads, TikTok Shop analytics, or Facebook monitoring.

faq.question: Can it tell me how many products sold?
faq.answer: No. Plays and likes are engagement measures, not verified purchase data.

faq.question: Should I paste my API key into the chat?
faq.answer: No. Provide it through the tool configuration and keep it out of prompts and shared logs.
